title: A Generalisation of the Concentration-of-Measure Phenomenon with Applications to Intersection Problems
summary: In this paper we prove a generalisation of the concentration-of-measure phenomenon in the discrete cube. In this setting, the concentration-of-measure phenomenon states that for every subset $\mathcal{A}$ of the discrete cube, its sum with a Hamming ball of suitably large radius $r$ -- or equivalently, its $r$-expansion -- results in a substantial increase in measure.
